verdict.rationale: Ramp documents an official remote MCP server at https://mcp.ramp.com/mcp, plus a demo endpoint, for connecting Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients, with admin role-based access controls and two additional scoped MCP servers (Developer and Data). A live probe confirms the server is OAuth-gated per the MCP authorization spec and publishes granular read/write scopes. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of agents actually using it, and bill approvals, which the docs say are not yet available via MCP.
